text:
nina (Design): quick sanity check on the private setup preflight UI. ran into a handful of small UX + copy things around the connectivity step. can we iterate?

alex (UX): yes. i'm seeing user confusion where the checkbox says "Run network tests". prefer "Run connectivity checks (recommended)" + a one-line explainer under it. also the CTA buttons are unclear: "Run checks" vs "Verify" — unify.

diego (Eng): behind the scenes our probe tries TCP handshake, then SSH if port 22, then an optional HTTP probe. it never sends credentials. we should show a short line: "No credentials are transmitted." also note: probes originate from 3 IPs (i'll paste the range).

nina (Design): can we show small status chips inline: SSH · HTTP · TCP with green/yellow/red? makes failures scannable. on failure, show a short action link like "Troubleshoot" that expands steps.

maya (Product): policy: for Private customers default the toggle OFF. hosted accounts default ON. also add a fallback: "Run checks locally" which downloads a small script. customers with strict egress can use it.

alex (UX): accessibility notes: ensure the toggle has an aria-describedby that includes the probe behavior and that the live region announces status updates. sample aria text: "Connectivity checks. Redwood will attempt a TCP handshake from its health-checker IPs. No credentials are used."

diego (Eng): implementing probe_details array for each check so frontend can render chips. also will add a signed-download endpoint for the local probe script. script will POST results to a signed URL and auto-expire.

nina (Design): proposed microcopy (short):

"Run connectivity checks (recommended)"
"Redwood will attempt a connection from our health-checker IPs to the host and port you provide. No credentials are used. If you'd prefer, download a local probe script to run inside your network."

Error copy idea (inline):
"SSH check failed — connection to bastion.acme.internal:22 timed out. Confirm egress to Redwood health-checker IPs or run the local probe."

Success chip: "Connectivity checks passed" (green)

alex (UX): keyboard flow: hitting Enter on the toggle should start checks. focus moves to a status region with role=status and polite live updates: "Connectivity checks running", then final state + suggested next step. ensure error links are keyboard focusable.

diego (Eng): small implementation note: logs may contain target host and probe IPs; we will strip any secrets. local probe will not upload config files, only handshake results.

maya (Product): add a small link under the toggle: "Privacy details" linking to a short blurb. nina, can you leave space in the mock for that?

nina (Design): will do. i'll mock the chips, toggle, and download CTA. tagging @alex for ARIA copy review when ready.

deploy-bot: staging rollout scheduled for 2025-11-13T03:30Z — heads up. :rocket:

maya (Product): perfect. i'll update the spec and call out default toggle behavior + local probe fallback. thanks everyone. :smile:
